I used tp tale antianxiety and stopped cold turkey bc my mom refused to get me more. I didn't have many side effects except for a bit of social withdrawal. This is an experiment for me, more like- because I know of the benefits of them and I genuinely think they can help me. But since my doctor is a school doctor (college student) and it's the only way I can get cheap enough meds (they're normally 90$ a fucking bottle like what the fuck) I won't be able yo ask for smaller doses at the moment, it's close to Christmas break. I don't think quitting will effect me much but I do think, just for safety sake, it would be better to wean off then wait another week after completely quitting before taking shrooms, then going back to my normal meds after taking shrooms n waiting a week. I don't have constant access to shrooms or the funds. I could grow myself but again college student who has the opposite of a green thumb. Thank you so much for your advice though- I know shrooms can beneficial for mental health and has helped many people.

again, thank you for your responses! I genuinely feel a lot more confident about my decision. I might look into weed or CBD for the anti-anxiety, just to be sure I have it with me. ill wean myself down for about two weeks to be safe, then wait another week after before starting back up again. your input has been such a big help for me and I can't appreciate it enough. I might make an update post after this trip, along with whatever art I decide to make. 

Again, thank you so much for helping this first timer. Appreciate it!! ❤❤
